content_of_post_to_answer: How do you seriously get over depression?
answer: Getting over depression is often misunderstood as trying to feel happy again, but many people recover by rebuilding trust in themselves first. The hidden battle is not only sadness; it is the belief that nothing they do matters. Small actions become powerful when they challenge that belief. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. Recovery often begins when life stops being measured by how you feel today and starts being measured by whether you are slowly reconnecting with yourself.
